## Problem

Describe the problem and link the relevant issue, if one exists.

## Change

Explain the behavior after this change and any compatibility or migration impact.

## Verification

List the commands or manual checks you ran and their results.

- [ ] The change is focused and follows the contribution guide.
- [ ] Code, comments and tests are in English.
- [ ] Behavior changes have appropriate regression coverage.
- [ ] No credentials, personal data or unrelated files are included.
- [ ] I have read the project's license and any required contributor agreement.
